properties.name: maple.framework.enable.mybatis-listener
properties.description: Enable MyBatis write-operation listeners. When false, declarations are neither resolved nor delivered.

properties.name: maple.framework.enable.mybatis-listener-async
properties.description: Enable after-commit asynchronous delivery. When false, async declarations are executed synchronously.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.deduplicate
properties.description: Invoke the same listener at most once per write operation. Disable to restore legacy multi-interface delivery.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.propagate-exception
properties.description: Rethrow listener exceptions to the business caller. Default isolates failures so committed writes are not rolled back. Applies to synchronous deliveries only: asynchronous callbacks are always isolated, and failures after a committed sync-after-commit transaction are contained and logged.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.sync-after-commit
properties.description: Defer synchronous listener callbacks until the surrounding transaction commits.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.strict-snapshot
properties.description: Report values that cannot be cloned as degraded snapshots instead of silently keeping references.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.metadata-cache-size
properties.description: Maximum number of cached listener declaration resolutions.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.metadata-cache-expire-seconds
properties.description: Idle expiration in seconds for the listener declaration resolution cache.

properties.name: maple.framework.mybatis.listener.slow-callback-threshold-ms
properties.description: Threshold in milliseconds above which a synchronous listener callback is logged as slow.
